heroSummary: For most LBUSD schools, the 2026–27 school year begins Tuesday, August 25, 2026, with a minimum day for students. The last day is Thursday, June 10, 2027. Fall break runs November 23–27, winter break runs December 21–January 1, and spring break runs April 5–9. CAMS and Sato begin August 12 and follow a separate calendar.

sourceReviewSummary: This page is based on the LBUSD calendar page, the official 2026–27 student calendar PDF, and the separate 2026–27 CAMS & Sato calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: August 5, 2026 — All dates shown on this page were checked against the applicable LBUSD calendar PDF.
We checked the first day, minimum-day note, last day, major breaks, no-school dates, back-to-school nights, quarter and semester dates, open house dates, and the CAMS & Sato calendar exception.
The PDF does not state a total number of instructional days. We calculated 180 weekdays from the first through the last student day after excluding every marked no-school date.

customSections.label: CAMS & Sato Calendar Differences
customSections.content: California Academy of Mathematics and Science (CAMS) and Sato Academy use a separate LBUSD calendar. Families at those schools should use the CAMS & Sato PDF instead of the general LBUSD calendar.

customSections.label: Academic Milestones and Family Events
customSections.content: LBUSD’s published calendar includes back-to-school nights, quarter and semester dates, and spring open houses. These dates are useful for planning, even when they are not days off from school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar apply to CAMS and Sato?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page summarizes the calendar used by most LBUSD schools. CAMS and Sato Academy publish a separate 2026–27 calendar, with classes beginning August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the first day of school a minimum day?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Classes begin Tuesday, August 25, 2026, and LBUSD lists the first day as a minimum day for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Does LBUSD have the full Thanksgiving week off?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. LBUSD’s fall break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026, covering the full Thanksgiving week. The district lists November 26–27 as Thanksgiving holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: When does school resume after winter and spring break?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes resume Monday, January 4, 2027, after winter break and Monday, April 12, 2027, after spring break.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar revisions?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official LBUSD calendar page for updates. The .ics file on this page is a one-time import and will not update automatically if LBUSD revises its calendar.
